title: ImageRequest
description: Params in for the text2image layer: one subject description plus sampler settings.

prompt.description: Subject description. The layer wraps it in a single-object framing template unless rawPrompt is true.

framing.description: Which framing template wraps the subject. auto reads the subject for words that mean a person or creature. character asks for a neutral A-pose facing the camera, which is the pose a rig needs and the view a face survives; object asks for a three-quarter product shot. Ignored when rawPrompt is true.

rawPrompt.description: Send prompt to the sampler verbatim, with no framing template.

seed.description: Omit for a deterministic seed derived from the prompt.

steps.description: FLUX.2 klein is distilled for 4 steps. More does not buy detail: the distilled endpoint ignores the parameter upstream, and pushing it produces a waxy, overcooked image. The ceiling is 8 so a caller can experiment without wrecking a render.

outDir.description: Directory the PNG is written to. The result envelope references it by path.
